decision.next_hypothesis: H014-SUB-009: the persistent collective fails closed on timeout, loss, partial, duplicate and stale responses, supports explicit cancellation and clean slot reuse, and never reduces an incomplete selected-expert set.

hypothesis.prediction: Persistent start/collect overlaps the parent-resident shared expert with routed workers while preserving exact batches 1/2/4/8; batch-8 wall p50 is <=16.74745 ms and p99 is <=19.02525 ms.

inspection.actual_bottleneck: Same-GPU CUDA-context contention consumes the theoretical overlap. Batch-8 complete p50/p99 is 17.4499/19.120186 ms versus H014-SUB-006f 17.4095/19.02525 ms. The async parent enqueue window is only 0.1704 ms, but collection wait rises to 7.9213 ms; routed critical worker device rises from 5.630304 to 7.0936 ms and profiled shared wall under concurrent worker activity is 4.708 ms versus the isolated 1.3241 ms reference. No shared wall is hidden on the one-GPU topology.
inspection.fixture_limitation: Three retained real boundaries are row-rotated; route overlap is real for this trace but not a production prompt distribution.
